name: Ahas
description: The first of a matched pair, and the lower of the two. A tight bowl of a place, walled to the height of a chest, with everything inside built small. Doors here are cut short and the steps are shallow. You feel oversized without being looked at.

pois.label: Low door
pois.text: Cut to below the lintel line, so anyone using it stoops. The threshold is hollowed in the middle by feet that always landed in the same place.

pois.label: Shallow steps
pois.text: Four risers where two would do. Each tread is barely deep enough for the ball of a foot, and the edges are not worn, which means nobody has hurried here.

pois.label: Chest-high wall
pois.text: You can rest your forearms on it and see over. On the outside the wall is finished. On the inside it is rough and has never been pointed.
